name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Abu Dhabi talks end; ZNPP worker killed 9 Nov
summary: Abu Dhabi talks ended 11 Nov without a deal; mass drone exchange overnight; IAEA says a Zaporizhzhia worker was killed
state: US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi ended their second day on 11 Nov without a concrete agreement; US envoys are due to meet President Putin in Moscow next (ABC News; Kyiv Post). Overnight, Russia's defence ministry said it downed 627 Ukrainian drones and Ukraine's air force reported 163 Russian drones plus missiles, with power substations hit. The IAEA said on 9 Nov a Zaporizhzhia plant worker was killed by a drone, after the plant lost off-site power for about 10 hours on 8 Nov (Kyiv Independent). These nuclear-safety incidents keep the Alert.
for_you: Infrastructure strikes on both sides affect Ukraine's power supply and Russian ports and airports. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine and parts of Russia's border regions.
rubric_hit: Alert: nuclear-plant safety incident (ZNPP worker killed 9 Nov; off-site power lost 8 Nov)
